verdicts.reason: A: the headline sits flush against the left canvas edge with no margin, and the translucent grey band behind it covers only the top line. The two info boxes are staggered on the right and run off the right edge, which leaves the lower-left of the canvas as empty dead space over a blurry, over-zoomed photo. B has a consistent left margin, and the headline lines up with the blue box, which makes a clear top-to-bottom stack. Its flaws are an orphaned empty grey bar floating above the headline, which looks like an artifact, and blue and black boxes with mismatched tops and heights; the black box's text is also cramped against its padding.
